verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Old Mac
Donald had a farm, E-I-E-I-O!
And on his farm he had a cow, E-I-E-I-O!
With a moo-moo here, and a moo-moo there,
Here moo, there moo, everywhere moo-moo,
Old Mac
Donald had a farm, E-I-E-I-O!
